content.comment_body: Is an SD card necessary to use [product_name]? If yes, what is the typical memory size required?
Welcome to the forum. Please avoid posting the same question multiple times. You have also created another topic about whether an SD card is needed to send a [product_name] project.

Thread closed due to duplicate questions. The alternate thread with the subject about sending [product_name] projects and SD card requirements is available within the [product_name] - Software conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is asking if an SD card is required to work with [product_name], and what memory size is needed. This highlights uncertainty around hardware requirements for deploying projects with this software, suggesting that clearer guidance may be needed.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants concise information about hardware needs, specifically SD card usage and recommended memory size, for deploying projects using [product_name].
